question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

One cannot exactly **__predict__** the way she behaves in public gatherings.
solution:
The correct answer is **"prefigure."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Predict" **means to say that something will happen in the future. ((किसी बात की) भविष्‍यवाणी करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Scientists still cannot **predict**__ exactly when earthquakes will happen.*
 
 
 
• **"Prefigure"** means to predict or foresee something. (किसी चीज़ की भविष्यवाणी या पूर्वानुमान करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The signs **prefigure**__ a storm approaching.*
 
 
 
• **"Prefigure"** is a suitable replacement for** "predict"** in the given sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Deliberate** means intentional or done on purpose. (निर्णय करने से पहले किसी बात को पूरी तरह सोचना-समझना, भलि-भाँति सोचना)
 
• **Precipitate** means to cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly. (किसी घटना को (विशेषतः प्रतिकूल घटना को) अचानक या समय से पूर्व घटित करना या होने देना)
 
• **Proliferate** means to increase rapidly in numbers or spread. (संख्‍या की दृष्टि से (किसी वस्‍तु की) तीव्रता से वृद्धि होना; प्रफलन होना)
